summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party is the market's favoured side. The Democratic candidates in four races also gained ground sharply: Josh Turek in [[Iowa]], Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]], James Talarico in [[Texas]] and Sherrod Brown in Ohio. The market lists each of those four contests as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds shifted sharply in several governor's races, with three of them now showing a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained a great deal of ground, and in [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms also rose sharply. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson saw a steep drop in chances.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning control of the House rose by a moderate amount today. The projected seat count recently changed to 248-187, up from 245-190, which means Democrats gain control. Three races are newly predicted flips: [[AZ-02 (Flagstaff & Maricopa)]], [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]] and [[VA-05 (Lynchburg & Charlottesville)]].
